description: Mind Distill Factory — 10 wisdom categories for classifying thinkers
classification_rule: Each person: 1 primary + up to 2 secondary categories

categories.description_zh: 军事战略、博弈论、竞争思维、风险评估、时机把握
categories.description_en: Frameworks for competitive thinking, risk assessment, and decisive action under uncertainty

categories.description_zh: 认识论、形而上学、伦理框架、意义建构、世界观
categories.description_en: Epistemology, metaphysics, ethics as framework, and meaning-making

categories.description_zh: 政治哲学、制度设计、权力运用、领导群体、合法性构建
categories.description_en: Political philosophy, institutional design, leadership of groups, and legitimacy

categories.description_zh: 商业战略、投资思维、组织设计、价值创造、资源配置
categories.description_en: Business strategy, investment thinking, organizational design, and value creation

categories.description_zh: 科学方法、知识范式、范式转换、好奇心驱动、严谨求证
categories.description_en: Scientific method, intellectual rigor, paradigm shifts, and curiosity as method

categories.description_zh: 艺术过程、审美判断、创新方法、工匠精神、跨界融合
categories.description_en: Artistic process, aesthetic judgment, creative discipline, and innovation

categories.description_zh: 个人伦理、习惯养成、人际关系、品格修炼、自律体系
categories.description_en: Personal ethics, habit formation, interpersonal relations, and integrity

categories.description_zh: 逆境智慧、危机应对、坚韧不拔、情绪掌控、苦难转化
categories.description_en: Suffering as teacher, crisis response, perseverance, and emotional mastery

categories.description_zh: 修辞说服、导师制、知识传递、文化塑造、启发式教育
categories.description_en: Rhetoric, persuasion, mentorship, knowledge transmission, and cultural change

categories.description_zh: 健康养生、人际关系、日常节律、老龄智慧、闲暇艺术、实用智慧
categories.description_en: Health, relationships, daily routines, aging, leisure, and practical wisdom
